plan.title: Edit Evaluation Time With Buyer Bid Editing Disabled

steps.note: Open the existing prepared live RFQ with Vendor A's bid; prepared-state cases must start here.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Keep counter offers visible on RFQs as required.
Allow bid rejection during bidding as required by the case configuration.
Set the final condition being tested: buyer bid editing is disabled.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case configuration.
Open the RFQ stage named in the case.
Open the Responses view where the buyer accesses stage actions.
Open Edit Evaluation Time, attempt to confirm the unchanged evaluation-time form, and assert Procol refuses the action under the disabled buyer-edit permission.
